zh-HK: CSV 自動載入密碼升級：密碼改用 PBKDF2-SHA256 加鹽儲存，取代舊 btoa；舊密碼登入一次就自動轉換，唔使重設
新增「記住呢部電腦」（7 / 30 / 90 日）：期間開平台唔使再輸入密碼，CSV 資料夾真正自動載入；改密碼後保留，可喺「📂 資料夾載入」取消
連續輸錯 5 次暫停 30 秒（再錯逐步加長）；密碼可顯示 / 隱藏、Caps Lock 提示、錯誤直接顯示喺對話框
更改密碼一頁完成：現有 / 新 / 確認密碼、強度提示、唔可以再用預設密碼；「📂 資料夾載入」面板新增「🔐 更改密碼」；忘記密碼重設中途取消唔會清走舊密碼
en: CSV auto-load password upgrade: stored with salted PBKDF2-SHA256 instead of btoa; existing passwords (including the default) convert automatically on next sign-in
New "Remember this computer" (7 / 30 / 90 days) so the CSV folder loads without typing the password; kept after a password change, removable in "📂 Folder sync"
Five wrong attempts pause input for 30s (growing after that); show/hide password, Caps Lock hint and inline errors
One-page password change with strength meter; the default password can no longer be reused; "🔐 Change password" added to the Folder sync panel; cancelling a reset no longer wipes the old password
